name: Recess Warden
lore: An owl playground guardian from Firstbell Elementary, bringing lunch mats and safe crossings to the Crossroads. A support hero with modest damage who can protect a party or sustain itself alone.

primary.name: Safety Whistle
primary.description: Send a 110-wide echo wave up to 400 reach. It pierces enemies for 18 damage each, once per cast. Walls block the wave. Nearby allies retain the 8% protective ward.

secondary.name: Snack Break
secondary.description: Place a lunch mat for 4s: heal friendly heroes 4 HP per second in a 120-radius area. Remove burn and poison once per guest. Does not heal enemies.

special.name: Crossing Patrol
special.description: A 210-wide line of cones advances for 3s. Push and slow each crossed foe once, intercept up to 16 enemy projectiles, and grant nearby allies 20% protection.

passive: Shared Recess: Friendly heroes inside Snack Break gain 10% damage reduction.

technique.name: Owl Eyes
technique.description: Replace Snack Break with two opposite, rotating 270-range energy beams for 2s. Aim to rotate the owl’s gaze; each beam ticks 5 damage every 0.25s. 11s cooldown. Gives up healing and cleansing.

attack.name: Owl Eyes
attack.description: For 2s, energy beams shine in front and behind you. Move your aim to rotate the gaze. Each foe takes at most one 5-damage tick every 0.25s; walls block beams.

final_technique.name: Playground Shelter
final_technique.description: Replace the moving patrol with a stationary 145-radius shelter for 4s. Grants 20% protection and heals 2 HP/s; catches six projectiles. No damage or knockback.

attack.name: Playground Shelter
attack.description: Place a stationary shelter for 4s. Protect and heal friendly heroes; absorb up to six hostile projectiles.
